A Schauder regularity theory for nonlocal viscous Hamilton–Jacobi equations
referaty.streszczenie: Viscous Hamilton–Jacobi equations arise as dynamic programming equations in optimal control and differential games, where the unknown function represents the value function of an optimally controlled process. We use a heat-semigroup approach to study the regularity of such equations with nonlocal and mixed local–nonlocal diffusions. Our framework covers a broad class of Lévy-type operators, including fractional Laplacians as well as nonsymmetric and strongly anisotropic operators. Using the Duhamel formulation together with smoothing estimates in Hölder spaces, we obtain optimal spatial Schauder estimates and explicit blow-up rates for higher-order Hölder norms as time approaches zero. referaty.tytul: Nierówności dualne w przestrzeniach $H_p$, $0<p<1$
Local functional equations for polynomials and related topics
referaty.sala: room D1.2, Building C-16, Wrocław University of Science and Technology
referaty.streszczenie: The functional equations for the Riemann zeta function have long been known to admit two classical proofs. One is based on the Mellin transform and an integral representation of the zeta function, while the other relies on Jacobi's theta function. Although these approaches are quite different, they are in fact two manifestations of the same underlying principle: The Poisson summation formula and the self-duality of the Fourier transform. The main theme of this lecture is how this remarkable phenomenon extends to higher dimensions. A successful framework for such a generalization is provided by the theory of prehomogeneous vector spaces, introduced by Mikio Sato. In this talk, I will discuss local functional equations associated with these spaces, the polynomials that satisfy them, and their intimate connections with representation theory, harmonic analysis and number theory, and…

referaty.tytul: Long time behaviour of mean field games with fractional diffusion
referaty.streszczenie: We discuss recent results on the long time behaviour of mean field games systems with fractional diffusion. The dynamics of the players are driven by independent jump processes, controlled through the drift, and confined by an external drift to guarantee ergodicity. In the case of globally Lipschitz, locally uniformly convex Hamiltonians, and weakly coupled and LL monotone costs, we prove that there is a unique solution $(u_T,m_T)$ to the problem in $(0,T)$, and we show that if T is sufficiently large, then $(u_T,m_T)$ satisfies the so-called turnpike property — it is exponentially close to the (unique) stationary ergodic state of the problem.

Regularity of maximal functions and a Vitali covering lemma for the boundary
referaty.streszczenie:
The classical Hardy-Littlewood maximal function theorem states that the Hardy-Littlewood maximal operator is a bounded operator on $L^p(\mathbb R^d)$ if and only if $1 < p \leq \infty$. The main ingredient to the proof is the Vitali covering lemma, which roughly states that any bounded set of balls has a pairwise disjoint subset which represents the volume of the original set well.
In 1997 Juha Kinnunen proved the corresponding result for the gradient of the maximal function, i.e. that the $L^p(\mathbb R^d)$-norm of the gradient of the maximal function is controlled by the $L^p(\mathbb R^d)$-norm of the gradient of the function if $1 < p \leq \infty$. However, he provides no counterexample in the endpoint $p = 1$, and so in 2004 Hajłasz and Onninen formally posed the question if the endpoint gradient bound also holds.

referaty.tytul: Algebry grafowe związane z operatorami kreacji na przestrzeniach Focka
referaty.streszczenie: Od czasu wprowadzenia przez W. A. Focka w 1932 roku bozonowych i fermionowych przestrzeni Focka, pojawiło się wiele różnych konstrukcji podobnego typu. Są one w naturalny sposób wyposażone w operatory kreacji i anihilacji, a algebry $C^*$ generowane przez te rodziny wykazują zaskakujące powiązanie z algebrami grafowymi. Podczas wykładu omówię dotychczas znane wyniki w tym zakresie oraz ich uogólnienie na algebrę generowaną przez nieskończenie wiele operatorów kreacji na boolowsko-antymonotonicznej przestrzeni Focka. Jest to wspólna praca z Jackiem Spielbergiem oraz Januszem Wysoczańskim.

Domain-aware matrix completion for phenotype imputation in electronic healthe records
referaty.streszczenie: Large-scale biobanks and electronic health records (EHR) offer great opportunities for next-generation genetic studies. However, missing phenotype data is a pervasive feature of EHR, leading to low power of such studies. One promising solution is prediction-powered inference, where statistical or machine learning models are employed to impute phenotypes prior to performing genetic analyses. Although many such methods exist, they tend to be generic and do not incorporate domain-aware knowledge to optimize their performance for downstream genetic analyses. We propose a novel matrix completion method, covImpute, which, unlike generic matrix completion methods such as softImpute, incorporates external information in the form of a genetic covariance matrix among phenotypic features and imputes missing entries with latent genetic components.
